cases.name: rollback-archive
cases.finding: Current installed CLI rejects corrupt state; actual native archive restores exact conversation and completed-command receipt, retaining damaged bytes.

scope: Linux current local tar candidate: actual installed CLI/desktop and source-matched native administrative archive helper. Scripted providers, private authenticated display, disposable corruption. No live-quality, duration, formal performance, signing or other OS acceptance.
limitations: Native archive helper is a source-matched administrative test executable, not a packaged end-user recovery UI.
Initial recovery fixture failed due to missing host.json and is retained.
GUI initial project reached its existing five-minute deadline during manual inspection and was explicitly restarted; raw observation retained.
Reference reports and accepted P01-P13 artifacts remain immutable.
